about_short_description.short_description: Bigger Picture is an online scheduling platform that connects warehousing, shipping, and transportation providers to improve supply chain.

product.name: Appointment Scheduling Automation
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates scheduling of freight shipments by connecting shippers, carriers, and warehouses to coordinate inbound and outbound appointments.

product.name: AI-Powered Scheduling
product.description: A scheduling system that uses AI and predictive analytics to optimize shipment appointment times and synchronize planning among supply chain stakeholders.

product.name: Adaptive Execution Management
product.description: A system that monitors shipments in real-time, detects risks or disruptions, and suggests corrective actions to maintain supply chain resilience and agility.

product.name: Synchronized Partner Coordination
product.description: A collaboration platform that provides real-time data sharing and a unified view of the appointment execution process among all supply chain partners.
